pages.text: Potion of Sparkling is the first alchemy base potion.$(br2)Drinking it restores 25% of your maximum mana.
Potion of Glittering is an improved alchemy base potion.$(br2)Drinking it restores 50% of your maximum mana.
Potion of Glowing is the most potent alchemy base potion.$(br2)Drinking it restores 100% of your maximum mana.
